watches.name: Black & Navy Bundle: BK33 & BK38
watches.description: Introducing the BK38: 38mm, dual-time GMT. Blok's first "grown up" watch Where the BK33 allows kids to learn their first time management skills, the BK38 is remarkably useful for the big kids to actually manage their time in the simplest form. 30 minutes of emails? Set a Blok. 15 minutes of social media? Set a Blok. 30 minutes until Negronis? Set a Blok. The BK38 has matured in a myriad of ways on its adventure to become a big kids' staple. Steel core: The watch possesses a heft not normally felt in polymer watches. GMT: Big kids travel so the BK38 is a fixed bezel dual-time watch with a subtle 24-hour internal chapter ring. The movement is from our long-time Swiss partner, Ronda. Lume: Yep. It glows. Crystal: Sapphire Rotating Bezel: Since this is our Discommon gang, Neil didn't settle on the click of the bezel until it matched the feel of his Artisans De Geneve Submariner. The click really might be the standout feature of the watch (yeah he's a geek). About the newly re-engineered BK33 Blok's inaugural timepiece, the Blok 33, is now re-engineered for its sophomore edition. A proper kids' wristwatch with all the watch fanatic bells and whistles: 33mm diameter ETA Swiss Quartz movement Sapphire Crystal lens Screw down crown (waterproof to 100m) WE LISTENED: Japanese lume in bezel and hands Bundles: We cannot accept partial returns for watches purchased in a bundle. Bundles can only be returned as the complete, 2-watch set. This includes the following: Glow Bundle: BK33 & BK38; Fuchsia & Grey Bundle: BK33 & BK38; Discommon Bundle: BK33 & BK38; Black & Navy Bundle: BK33 & BK38

watches.name: Blok 33 - Discommon Edition
watches.description: We partnered with design firm and Blok's partners-in-mischief, Discommon, to bring a version of our inaugural timepiece in a colorway that is truly...dis-common. The new BK33 is re-engineered for its sophomore edition. A proper kids' wristwatch with all the watch fanatic bells and whistles: 33mm diameter ETA Swiss Quartz movement Sapphire Crystal lens Screw down crown (waterproof to 100m) WE LISTENED - Japanese lume in bezel and hands Blok 33 utilizes our unique visual time management system: our proprietary rotating bezel, broken into 4 simple timer “bloks” and our dial, itself a reimagining of traditional time markers. The watch comes with a "universal" run-thru buckle strap. This style of strap is designed to fit all wrist sizes and is easy to swap out for specific sized velcro straps available in our strap shop.

watches.name: Blok 31 - Turquoise
watches.description: Introducing the Blok 31, our sophomore timepiece designed for clear and intuitive time telling. We removed the timer bezel, simplifying the dial and highlighting our iconic offset hour bloks. BK31 also features the much anticipated addition of lume. The hands, dial and even the recessed minutes in the case all glow. 31mm Case Diameter Ronda Swiss Quartz movement Mineral Crystal lens Screw down crown (waterproof to 100m) LUMINOVA on hands and dial LUMINOVA minutes in the case The design focus for this wristwatch was teaching our youngest kiddos to read time. Though little future astronauts were the target, we landed on a unique and modern watch suited to any age group. The watch comes with a matching small size strap, fitting a range of 5" - 6" wrist circumference. This comfortable, run-thru strap is easy to adjust and swap out for different colors or sizes .
